question.summary: The strong equal-weight conjecture holds for every qubit-input channel, cq and qc channels, and a positive-measure set in all dimensions. The weak form holds for qutrit endomorphisms.
question.importance: The conjecture is a channel analogue of decomposing a matrix into controlled low-rank pieces. A proof would reduce arbitrary channels to equal mixtures of low-Choi-rank maps and sharpen the convex geometry of quantum operations.
question.unresolved: Prove or refute the strong decomposition conjecture for arbitrary input and output dimensions.

claims.title: Large channel classes satisfy the conjectured decomposition
claims.text: Kumar and Wolf prove the strong form for qubit input, cq and qc channels, and a nonzero-measure set in every dimension; the general case remains open.
